bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the homogenization of cloned voices by comparing non-native English source audio to cloned outputs, using human annotator ratings for perceived 'nativeness' and the automated CommonAccent model to track shifts toward dominant Anglophone accents.

Stratifying human annotations of stylistic traits (such as warmth and authoritativeness) by speaker sex, and measuring the rate of cross-sex misidentification (female-to-male and male-to-female) using speaker identity classification probes on audio embeddings.
